title: Signature Study — Apochromatic refractor concept (254 mm f/5)
description: This is a Signature-authored optical design study for a apochromatic refractor at 254 mm f/5. Design goals address the real aberration profile: Reflecting designs are inherently free of chromatic aberration. Spherical aberration: edge rays of a spherical mirror focus closer than axial rays; a parabolic figure removes it on axis. Corrected with a coma corrector lens. Intended application: planetary observation.
